title: Teach a procedure once, then recall it
statement: Teach a procedure in full once, and open each later lesson that uses it by recalling it rather than teaching it again from zero.
detail: A review of a Grade 3 reading course objected that a skill already taught several times was being introduced again in detail. The ruling keeps each procedure's first teaching as the one full teach and has every later lesson open on recall of the procedure rather than re-defining it. It is a course ruling, and no outcome was measured.

evidence.quote: A skill or tool page after its procedure's first teaching opens on recall, not re-teaching from zero.
infer has already been taught multiple times. We don't need to introduce the infer skill in so much detail.
stay untouched as the one full teach; every later lesson recalls the procedure rather than re-defining it
